title: cubric.studio revamp for 2.0: the landing page shows what Cubric Studio is (MCP, in-app agent, paid cloud models)
description: Fabio 2026-09-29: the website is one of the last 2.0 blockers (MPI-595). A full revamp of C:/AI/Mpi/Cubric Studio (Website), Cubric Studio as the only product (the Prompt, Audio and Video pages go, decided 2026-09-25). The landing page must show what the app actually is, with its own sections for: (1) connecting an outside AI agent over MCP, with a download button for the Claude Desktop extension (.mcpb, whose one home is the cubric-studio-agents repo's releases); (2) the in-app agent, a big 2.0 feature; (3) the new paid cloud models on the user's own DeepInfra key. /privacy/ must stay at the same URL. Scope, constraints and sources: brief.md. The docs website is separate work (Fabio has an agent on it).
